{{Top}}
'''Coachelle Automata''' was the manufacturer of the [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Coachelle Automata was created by [[Jason Fry]] for the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']]. The [[Coachelle system/Legends|Coachelle system]] is home to the [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which resemble rabbits. The rabbit-like ears on the LEP servant droid further reinforce the connection between the company and the Lepi species.
